# SD13-E4 cleric level 1 prepared divine spell-burden baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric level 1 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat)
# and stays a single-class, level-1-only prepared divine spell-bearing baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every spell-support surface: no spellbook, no spells prepared,
# no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain power execution, and no
# general spell totals. Channel Energy's flat die-count and uses-per-day math is
# grounded for real from this fixture's level and Charisma score. It adds only the
# minimum choice data needed to make the Cleric class identity, the domain choice
# burden, and the prepared divine spell posture burden legible; those two burdens are
# intentionally left for the runtime and matrix to name as still blocking.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level1
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:1
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
